deviations.detail: Spec item 3 says row/hero numbers count up 'when their block reveals'. CountUp instead owns its own RAF and starts on mount (self-contained), per the hard constraint that CountUp must own its animation state so App's post-mount isAdmin re-render cannot reset/blank it. This means below-the-fold row numbers may finish counting before the row scrolls into view. Final text is byte-identical (Math.round(to)+suffix). Trade-off chosen deliberately to satisfy the re-render-safety constraint over exact reveal-gating.

deviations.area: RangeList empty-row opacity vs reveal fade
deviations.detail: Rows carried an inline opacity (empty ? 0.45 : 1). Inline opacity outranks the .reveal/.reveal.in class rules, which would have killed the fade for every row. Fix: filled rows now get NO inline opacity (reveal drives their 0->1 fade); empty/placeholder rows keep inline opacity:0.45 and therefore appear immediately at their dimmed final look without a fade. Empty rows are dimmed placeholders, so no visible-content regression. No color/spacing/layout change.

To honor 'no color change', .sky in index.css supplies ONLY `animation: drift 30s ease-in-out infinite` and is applied to the EXISTING hero overlay div (which keeps its original inline radial-gradient). The reference's .sky rule (which sets its own multi-stop colored gradient + inset:-30% + z-index) was intentionally NOT copied, since that would alter hero visuals/colors. Motion behavior matches; visuals unchanged.

Hero wind stat now renders via CountUp to={day.wind} suffix=' km/h'. Per the hard constraint the acceptance is 'final text == Math.round(to)+suffix'. Wind is entered via a stepper (typically integer) so this is normally byte-identical; if a fractional wind were ever stored it would round to nearest integer (allowed by the stated constraint).

Used a targeted stage (index.html, src/, specs/) rather than `git add -A`. The untracked read-only handoff artifacts (.lmdn-handoff/ and la-meteo-de-nico-handoff.zip) were intentionally left unstaged since they are reference material, not part of this feature. .claude/ is gitignored.

manual_verification: Entrance reveals: masthead (d1), hero (d2), list header (d3), rows (staggered 0.05s each), note, footer fade+rise on first paint; below-fold rows reveal on scroll.
Gauge draw: each almanac row temperature bar scales from the left as the row reveals (.bar-fill inside .reveal.in).
Thermo dots: the two hero endpoint dots pop in ~0.55s after the hero reveals (.dot inside .reveal.in).
Ambient drift: hero gradient overlay drifts continuously (~30s loop).
Reduced motion (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): all reveals start visible/static, no count-up loop (final value immediate), no drift, gauges/dots at final state.
Print: page fully visible (not blank) with all reveal/gauge/dot elements forced to final state.
New type renders: serif in Newsreader (headline numbers use serif italic), mono/labels in IBM Plex Mono.
CountUp survives App's post-mount isAdmin re-render without resetting/blanking.
